verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents ready-made integrations for instrumenting apps. These include `wrap_openai`, a drop-in OpenAI client wrapper that logs all LLM calls, plus Anthropic SDK tracing. The docs also describe generic "integrate with AI providers and frameworks" support, Go `trace/contrib` auto-instrumentation packages, and a no-code Java agent. One community comment calls integration options "limited", but that is general sentiment, not a concrete counter-example. missing for 10: explicit evidence of LangChain and Vercel AI SDK integrations, independent hands-on corroboration of the framework integrations.
